verdict.rationale: Clara documents registrable webhook subscriptions: you supply a callback URL, the transaction statuses you care about, and a signing secret, and Clara POSTs HMAC-SHA256-signed events to your URL. A sandbox endpoint can also trigger test webhook events on demand (one attempt, no retries). Missing for 10: evidence of event types beyond transaction statuses, production delivery/retry guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
